extrapolation.interpretation: Extrapolations are arithmetic projections from the representative sample, not a national build. The area-scaled row is preferred because the sample over-represents small PEI tiles.

full_run.statement: This is staged national coverage. The full national 30-m build is a distributed/storage-scale operation; do not claim full coverage until all 3,562 datasets are built and validated.

stage1.note: deterministic highest-harvest tiles with eligible blocks; this is transition evidence, not a national simulation

scope.full_national_statement: The full national 30-m tiled build is 3,562 per-node WS4 datasets (one per committed 50-km supply node, clipped to its province). Staged national coverage is in progress; only validated tiles present on disk are counted. A full national claim requires all 3,562 datasets built and validated.
